title: Reduction Operations to Make the Array Elements Equal
goal: Count reductions needed to make every value equal by repeatedly lowering a maximum to the next distinct value.
strategy: After sorting, a value crosses one reduction level for each distinct smaller value. Add its level count once per occurrence.
